description: A shell script for testing concurrent git svn dcommit operations, including setup of SVN repositories, hooks, and various test cases for conflict resolution and rebase behavior.

methods.name: setup_hook
methods.description: Configures SVN hooks (pre-commit or post-commit) to simulate failures or concurrent commits.

methods.name: check_contents
methods.description: Checks the contents of files in the SVN working directory against expected states.

methods.name: delete_first_line
methods.description: Removes the first line from a specified file.
